## Model Entry

The Julia module entrypoint is exposed via a Pixi task:

```bash
pixi run run-model
```

Equivalent direct Julia call:

```bash
julia --project=. scripts/run_model.jl
```

## Minimal API Sketch

```julia
using CompassParfait

cfg = CompassParfait.load_config("config/default.toml")
data = CompassParfait.load_data(cfg)
fit  = CompassParfait.fit_model(data, cfg)
CompassParfait.save_outputs(fit, "artifacts/")
```

## Documentation Targets

This page is intended to host:

- model equations and assumptions,
- coupling/parameter organization,
- bin-connection strategy,
- normalization definition and computation.
